evals.name: data_workbook_requires_normalized_output
evals.prompt: Use the XLSX canary skill on a flat data workbook with no formulas.
evals.expected: The agent classifies the workbook as data, records public_fixture_id/url/sha256 evidence, generates parser/schema code, and emits normalized output proof without treating layout metadata as extracted facts.

evals.name: formula_workbook_requires_code_or_evaluator_proof
evals.prompt: Use the XLSX canary skill on a workbook with formulas, cross-sheet references, and named ranges.
evals.expected: The agent separates input cells from formula logic, refuses cached values as proof, and requires a code artifact or evaluator adapter before marking output verified.

evals.name: guarded_workbook_defers_explicitly
evals.prompt: Use the XLSX canary skill on a protected workbook or workbook with unsupported logic.
evals.expected: The agent classifies the workbook as guarded or unsupported and records an explicit deferral reason instead of silently extracting tables.

evals.name: ace_wave2_data_workbook_maps_without_route_collision
evals.prompt: Map an ACE wave-2 flat .xlsx inventory into the ingestion ledger.
evals.expected: The agent preserves original_canary_class=data, sets workbook_class=data_workbook, keeps route_target as a separate #65 route value, and records known spreadsheet losses.

evals.name: ace_wave2_calculation_requires_triplet
evals.prompt: Map an ACE wave-2 workbook inventory with formulas and cached values.
evals.expected: The agent preserves the calculation or mixed canary class, sets workbook_class=calculation_workbook, refuses cached_values_only verification, and requires input_contract, code_artifact, and output_proof.

evals.name: ace_wave2_report_inventory_is_metadata_only
evals.prompt: Map a chart-heavy workbook inventory with no formula proof lane.
evals.expected: The agent emits report_evidence from chart inventory fields and routes report_workbook as metadata_only unless a separate report-lane proof exists.

evals.name: ace_wave2_legacy_and_macro_logic_defer
evals.prompt: Map .xls, .xlsb, .ods, protected, macro-enabled, or external-link workbook evidence.
evals.expected: The agent does not count those sources as content-ingestion successes without adapter or static-analysis approval, records macro/external/protection flags, and emits excluded_workbook or explicit deferral reasons.
